name: Factory Lollipop
description: A factory-pattern library for generating valid, short-lived Drupal test data (nodes, types, fields, taxonomy, users, roles, menus, files, media) from reusable blueprints, for use in automated tests and developer/CLI code.
project_description: Factory Lollipop provides the factory design pattern for building short-lived, valid Drupal test data. A developer writes small Factory classes (implementing Drupal\factory_lollipop\FactoryInterface) that register named blueprints on the Drupal\factory_lollipop\FixtureFactory service (factory_lollipop.fixture_factory), then calls FixtureFactory::create($name, $overrides) inside PHPUnit kernel/functional tests, setUp/tearDown, or developer/CLI code to instantiate and persist real entities with sensible random defaults. Each blueprint declares a data 'type' string; a tagged-service chain (ChainFactoryTypeResolver) dispatches the type to the first matching FactoryType (FactoryTypeInterface) implementation. Built-in FactoryTypes cover node type, node, entity field, entity reference field, vocabulary, taxonomy term, role, user, menu, menu link, file, media type and media; the factory_lollipop_paragraphs submodule adds paragraph and paragraph type. New or overriding FactoryTypes and Factories are added purely as tagged services (factory_lollipop.factory_type_resolver / factory_lollipop.factory_resolver) with a priority, so projects can decorate or replace any type. Reusable traits (RandomGeneratorTrait, UserCreationTrait, EntityReferenceTestTrait) supply random-value and user/role/reference-field helpers. The module ships no routes, controllers, forms, permissions, config objects, config schema, entities, hooks (beyond hook_help), Drush commands or runtime/cron behaviour — it is a developer/test-only library invoked on demand from trusted code, never from an HTTP request.
